policy: A finding is allowlisted only when its file and rule are listed here and the count does not exceed max_count. Any new finding in these files, or any finding elsewhere, blocks.

entries.reason: Deliberately fake values used to prove the production secret guard rejects placeholder and short secrets. Never valid anywhere.
The registry login step binds a Jenkins credential to an environment variable name inside withCredentials. The flagged text is that variable name, not a value.
